prompt:
Redraw the user's latest attached Wilderland woodland people group illustration as a polished horizontal landscape illustration. Preserve FOUR distinct adult humans and their relative arrangement: at left an older standing bearded man with a fur-trimmed soft cap, weathered cloak, practical belted tunic and a walking staff by his side, hands together near waist; front center-left a seated elderly woman with a wrapped cloth head covering, deeply expressive dignified face, layered rough-edged cape, plain long dress and simple necklaces, one hand relaxed on her knee and the other open in a conversational gesture, seated on a low plain wooden stool; center-right a standing adult woman hunter with long hair beneath a practical cap, modest belted woodland tunic and leggings, small shoulder cape, a bow held upright at rest and small quiver by her side, other hand at hip; at right a tall broad adult man with a thick beard and fur-edged cap, simple shoulder cloak over sturdy long tunic, loose trousers and boots, a long-handled plain forestry axe balanced safely across his shoulder with one hand on haft, a round shield strapped behind him. Distinct expressive faces, natural hands and believable tools. Rugged capable forest dwellers with quiet dignity, not caricatures or battle poses. Keep standing/seated mix and ordinary hand-crafted clothing with restrained geometric edging.
Use same style as recent horizontal hobbit, Bree, ranger, Lindon, Barding, Beorning and Mirkwood redraws: fine warm muted brown pencil and pen contours, moderate selective directional hatching and limited crosshatching in hair and cloth recesses, small rich brown darks beneath overlaps, broad pale cream-paper highlights. Nearly white ivory paper background with faint sketch marks immediately behind group and beneath feet fading into blank. Approximately 16:10 horizontal composition, all four full figures comfortably spread across frame. All heads, boots, stool, bow tips, axe and shield inside generous pale margins, no cropping. No scenery, lettering, border, watermark or full color. Latest attached image is composition and costume reference; redraw cleanly without screenshot artifacts. Four characters only.
